reviews.text: Vusko is absolutely not anxious when he has to come in and remains calm during treatment. The vets are professional and gentle.
Very available and welcoming, even on a Friday evening at 5pm without an appointment.

They refused to prescribe painkillers for my Chihuahua who had just been bitten.

This clinic has a really bad attitude. I already had a problem with them a few years ago when they forcibly kept my cat hospitalized. I was supposed to pick her up on a Saturday, but they refused, and since it was a public holiday, I couldn't get her back until Tuesday.
All this just to make money.
Anyway, when you see the state of the premises, you understand if they're just there to collect the fees.

I want to thank the entire team for their kindness, advice, and for reassuring us.

Sincerely,
Athena's mother.

Excellent experience with Dr. Roux. A very attentive and professional veterinarian who takes the time to care for her patients. After months of searching for a suitable vet for our cat who was self-mutilating, she found the right treatment while maintaining reasonable prices.

Thanks also to the veterinary assistants for their kindness.
Very competent and friendly!

Avoid this veterinary clinic at all costs! They steal from their customers as soon as you buy anything. I dealt with a beardy guy with glasses who refused to admit his dishonesty and stole €9 from me, which he must have pocketed. He's certainly dishonest. Furthermore, I have the receipt he gave me personally confirming that the three items I had already paid for were still unavailable. The delivery driver didn't show up for the clinic on the day I was supposed to pick them up. The guy made up some excuse to tell me a load of nonsense. Be very careful. They're not friendly, I find them unfriendly and rude, and they take forever to serve you, even when you're alone at the clinic. If I could give zero stars, I would without hesitation. The thief will know who he is.
Very satisfied with the care provided by Dr. Roux. Accurate diagnosis, sound advice, and a very gentle approach with animals. He has become our go-to veterinarian. Thank you!

I had my two cats spayed at this clinic, and I highly recommend it. The care and follow-up were very professional, even though the two cats were reluctant; they were very patient. I live a bit far away, and the veterinary clinic near my home, which I've been going to for years for all my pets, is also very good. Long live this clinic and the team!

Fabulous!
They take great care of both the animal and its owners, and they take all the time necessary—a clear calling! As my son says, "It's a shame they're not also doctors for humans." We all travel across Lyon so our dog can be seen at this clinic!
Excellent veterinarian, efficient and friendly assistants.

Best vet in the 69 (Rhône) region! I tried many vets before finally finding this very professional one who takes good care of my American Staffordshire Terrier and treats her well. I highly recommend this vet.

I used to have my two cats treated by Dr. Beauvallet, and I was very satisfied. I lived next to the clinic. I was very happy with his care. I moved to Croix-Rousse, but I still went down to Bellecour. Then I had an emergency with one of my cats. The vet near my house saw me quickly. He was professional, but expensive. Unfortunately, I had to have my cat euthanized on Monday. Two injections, 10 minutes, 190 euros. I will go back to this clinic to have my cat treated. Professional, welcoming, reasonable prices, and competent.

Dr. Beauvallet is an excellent doctor. Always attentive, non-judgmental, and very patient with my dog, who is a bit grumpy at the vet. He's very kind; I've been going to him for nine years now, and he's always given great advice. The team is very friendly. In short, a vet like they used to make.
My animals are treated there and everything has always gone very well. Dr. Beauvallet is incredibly gentle with the animals, and so is the team. My dog ​​Tino is even happy to go there.

Veterinary clinic near Place Bellecour.
Easy access on the ground floor.
Dr. Beauvalet is a must-visit in Lyon, both professionally and personally 🤩👍 He listens attentively and explains things clearly, adapting to even the most diverse clientele ☺️ I can only remain loyal to a professional of this caliber (15 years already)!

But don't all come at once, as it's quite busy 😅
I called to make an appointment for a vaccination, but they didn't even bother to do it and told me to go see another vet. I wouldn't recommend them.
Dr. Beauvallet is a very good veterinarian.
A pleasant and helpful welcome, I recommend it. Thank you to them!
Very good, I've been a loyal customer for over 20 years, thank you to the whole team

What lovely staff! I'm an American who moved to Lyon this year and adopted my dog. It's a wonderful place. The receptionists are friendly, and the veterinary technicians are knowledgeable and patient. The doctors are honest and not trying to make money off me or cause me more problems. My dog ​​needed surgery, and they were very kind and helpful. She recovered very well afterward. I'm very happy with my experience and will continue to take my little one to the clinic.
The team is very nice and responsive. Will be visiting with all of my pet's treatments
The staff were very caring. They looked after my dog ​​for 15 years and took excellent care of him until the very end (so much so that we got another dog 3 months later ;))

Thank you to the entire clinic team for being so kind, tactful, and for supporting me with such gentleness and understanding during my cat's final days. While you cannot lessen the grief, you helped, in your own way, to reduce my stress by answering all my questions and being so available. I am very grateful.
Incredibly kind professionals. Very attentive and provided excellent care. I'm so glad I found this veterinary clinic.
Thank you very much for seeing me without an appointment. The doctor provided treatment plans and professional recommendations.
Excellent service and attention, we had an emergency with my cat, and they treated us very well; the reception staff and the doctor were very empathetic.

Had to book a last minute appointment since I had to cancel our other veterinarian appointment due to unforeseen events and luckily they had availability on the next day in the morning. The tapeworm treatment was done nicely and the vet is very professional.
Punctual and professional veterinarian

I took my puppy for her vaccinations and it was a positive experience. She received a complete check-up, all my questions were answered, and the prices were reasonable. The doctor and staff were friendly and knowledgeable. I will definitely return and recommend this clinic.
Top-notch as usual with animals, even when misfortune strikes, and very kind with humans... Very professional assistants
